page: Google Cloud Platform x5-2064-48t-metal is a bare-metal memory-optimized server instance within the x5 family. Designed for extreme enterprise memory workloads, it features 2,064 dedicated vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture and a total system memory capacity of 49,152 GB. This provisions approximately 23.81 GB of RAM per vCPU, placing it in an ultra-dense memory classification suitable for large-scale in-memory computing.

The hardware profile is specialized for large memory footprint tasks without bundled local disk storage or attached discrete GPUs. Infrastructure designs relying on x5-2064-48t-metal require network-attached cloud storage solutions for persistent data management. With no discrete GPUs included, acceleration tasks relying on specialized graphics or vector processors are omitted in favor of massive host memory density and raw x86_64 CPU core capacity.

From a resource density and cost efficiency perspective, x5-2064-48t-metal consolidates heavy enterprise database instances or massive SAP HANA footprints into a single bare-metal host. This high consolidation minimizes hypervisor overhead and network hops across distributed nodes, though the primary tradeoff remains complete dependence on external network storage solutions. Ideal workload fits include enterprise-grade in-memory databases, large-scale analytics platforms, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
description: Google Cloud Platform x5-2064-48t-metal is an ultra-dense bare-metal memory-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 2,064 dedicated vCPUs and 49,152 GB of RAM, resulting in approximately 23.81 GB of memory per core. The server includes no local persistent storage and no discrete GPUs, prioritizing extreme host memory capacity and unmitigated bare-metal vCPU access. This configuration avoids hypervisor overhead, making it efficient for consolidating large enterprise databases or in-memory analytics onto a single physical machine rather than scaling across distributed clusters. Storage requirements must be satisfied through external network-attached block volumes. x5-2064-48t-metal is engineered primarily for massive in-memory databases, SAP HANA deployments, and memory-heavy enterprise analytics workloads.
